Classify medical devices

classifyMedicalDevices.Rd

Uses an ellmer Chat object (e.g., ellmer::chat_google_gemini() or ellmer::chat_ollama()) to classify device data on the following:

  • Is a device: Flags whether each item is truly a medical device ("yes" or "no"), excluding non-device products such as creams, pharmaceuticals, integral drug-device medicines, and nutritional feeds.

  • Class: Assigns medical devices to an EU/UK MDR risk class (Class I, Class IIa, Class IIb, Class III) or EU/UK IVDR risk class (IVD (Class A), IVD (Class B), IVD (Class C), IVD (Class D)).

  • FDA medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices to an FDA clinical speciality (18 clinical specialities plus Other).

  • MHRA medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices to an MHRA speciality (10 clinical specialities plus Other).

  • EMA medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices to an EMA Medical Device Expert Panel (12 thematic panels plus Other).

  • EMDN category: Assigns true medical devices to a top-level European Medical Device Nomenclature (EMDN) category (23 lettered categories, A-Z including Annex XVI Category X, plus Other).

  • Implantable: Flags whether medical devices are implantable ("yes" or "no").

  • Active status: Flags whether medical devices are active/powered ("yes" or "no").

  • Software status: Flags whether medical devices are standalone Software as a Medical Device / SaMD ("yes" or "no").

Usage

classifyMedicalDevices(chat, data, maxRetries = 3L, batchSize = 1L)

Arguments

chat

An ellmer Chat object (such as from ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4o-mini") or ellmer::chat_ollama(model = "qwen2.5:7b", api_args = list(temperature = 0))).

data

A data.frame or tibble containing a device_name column which will be used to classify devices.

maxRetries

Maximum number of attempts for any concept before returning NA_character_.

batchSize

Number of unique device names to classify per LLM request. Keep this low (e.g., 1L-5L) for smaller local models to maintain structured-output reliability, and higher (e.g., 20L-50L) for larger frontier models to reduce request overhead and latency.

Value

A tibble with the original rows and columns of data, plus:

  • is_medical_device: Character ("yes", "no", or NA_character_).

  • device_class: Character ("Class I", "Class IIa", "Class IIb", "Class III", "IVD (Class A)", "IVD (Class B)", "IVD (Class C)", "IVD (Class D)", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • fda_medical_speciality: Character (one of the 19 FDA medical specialities, or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • mhra_medical_speciality: Character (one of the 11 MHRA medical specialities, or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • ema_medical_speciality: Character (one of the 13 EMA medical specialities, or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • emdn_category: Character (one of the 23 EMDN top-level categories or "Other", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • is_implantable: Character ("yes", "no", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • is_active: Character ("yes", "no", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • is_software: Character ("yes", "no", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(dplyr)
library(ellmer)

devices <- tibble(
  device_id = 1:5,
  device_name = c(
    "Medtronic Micra AV",
    "Stryker Triathlon CR Femoral Component",
    "FreeStyle Optium blood glucose test strips",
    "BD Alaris GP Volumetric Pump",
    "Diprobase cream"
  )
)

# Using a cloud model (e.g., Google Gemini or OpenAI)
chat <- chat_google_gemini(model = "gemini-2.5-flash")
res <- classifyMedicalDevices(chat, devices)

# Or using a local model via Ollama
local_chat <- chat_ollama(
  model = "qwen2.5:7b",
  api_args = list(temperature = 0)
)
res_local <- classifyMedicalDevices(
  local_chat,
  devices,
  batchSize = 1L
)
} # }
